import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Load the libraries in the correct order
ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define the GSL matrix structure
class GSLMatrix(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ("size1", ctypes.c_size_t),
        ("size2", ctypes.c_size_t),
        ("tda", ctypes.c_size_t),
        ("data", ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)),
        ("block", ctypes.c_void_p),
        ("owner", ctypes.c_int)
    ]

# Define function prototypes
gsl.gsl_matrix_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(GSLMatrix)
gsl.gsl_matrix_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t]

gsl.gsl_matrix_set.restype = None
gsl.gsl_matrix_set.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GSLMatrix), ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_double]

gsl.gsl_matrix_get.restype = ctypes.c_double
gsl.gsl_matrix_get.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GSLMatrix), ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t]

gsl.gsl_matrix_free.restype = None
gsl.gsl_matrix_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GSLMatrix)]

def create_and_manipulate_matrix():
    # Allocate a 2x2 matrix
    matrix = gsl.gsl_matrix_alloc(2, 2)

    # Set elements in the matrix
    gsl.gsl_matrix_set(matrix, 0, 0, 1.0)
    gsl.gsl_matrix_set(matrix, 0, 1, 2.0)
    gsl.gsl_matrix_set(matrix, 1, 0, 3.0)
    gsl.gsl_matrix_set(matrix, 1, 1, 4.0)

    # Retrieve elements from the matrix
    result = [
        [gsl.gsl_matrix_get(matrix, 0, 0), gsl.gsl_matrix_get(matrix, 0, 1)],
        [gsl.gsl_matrix_get(matrix, 1, 0), gsl.gsl_matrix_get(matrix, 1, 1)]
    ]

    # Free the matrix
    gsl.gsl_matrix_free(matrix)

    return result

def assert_test():
    # Call the function and verify the result
    result = create_and_manipulate_matrix()
    expected = [[1.0, 2.0], [3.0, 4.0]]

    # Use numpy for comparison to handle floating-point precision
    assert np.allclose(result, expected), f"Expected {expected}, but got {result}"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
